subject: Orchestrated onboarding: proposal for console + API deep-dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Orchestrated onboarding: proposal for console + API deep-dive

Hi Sam,

Great to meet last week — thanks for the productive call. Per our discussion, we'd like to propose a two-hour kickoff session combining: a short Console walkthrough (30–40 mins), a hands-on API enablement lab (60–70 mins), and a 10–20 minute Q&A and next-steps block.

A few things we want to cover:
- Console: project setup, model routing, and per-route cost visibility
- API: auth, rate limits, streaming responses, and SDK examples
- Lab: call + streaming sample, KV cache demo, and simple fallback policy

Proposed windows (all US/PST):
- Tue Nov 24, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–15:00
- Mon Nov 30, 09:00–11:00

Please let us know which slot works and who from your team will attend (engineer + security/procurement if possible). Also, could you share a test API key or short-lived credentials for the lab environment, or let us know whether we should provision sandbox access on your side?

Attached: session_agenda_v2.pdf (draft) and a short preflight checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: session_agenda_v2.pdf, FinWorks_preflight_checklist.pdf
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@finworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finworks.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orchestrated onboarding: proposal for console + API deep-dive

Marissa —

Thanks, this looks great. We prefer the Mon Nov 30 slot but our lead engineer (based on EST) will only be available in the afternoon local time. Can you do Mon Nov 30, 13:00–15:00 EST (that's 10:00–12:00 PST)? If not, Wed Nov 25 at 13:00 PST would be our backup.

Attendees likely: Sam Turner (engineering lead), Laura Chen (procurement lead), Diego Morales (platform eng) — I'll confirm full list tomorrow. For the sandbox, we have a short approval process; I can request a temporary token for you, but that will take a day. If Redwood can run the lab against a Redwood-hosted sandbox and we simply remove customer data, that may be faster.

Also: procurement will need the PO path and who to invoice. Laura is looped above.

Best,
Sam

We can run the hands-on lab against a Redwood sandbox to avoid approvals. I'll provision a scoped API key that expires in 48 hours and limits token usage to the demo model. Can you confirm Diego's GitHub handle so we can add him to the access allowlist?

- I'll be session lead for the API lab (requests, streaming, KV cache)
- Tessa will run the Console walkthrough and walk through per-route dashboards
- We'll record and provide the recording and the post-session runbook
